body:
Founder real-time: 'make sure the whole thing is built with bazel.' Added MODULE.bazel/.bazelrc/.bazelversion (pinned 9.2.0) + real BUILD.bazel cc_library/cc_binary targets for packages/common, packages/simulation, apps/server, apps/client -- same real precedent PARENA/ECOWAR's own Bazel setup already establishes, no new pattern invented. Verified: bazel build //... succeeds clean, and the Bazel-built racer_server binary runs identically to the gcc-built one (confirmed live, not assumed). Added a real .gitignore (this repo never had one). ci.yml's own gcc build path is untouched, stays as the fast CI path. Commits f576ce7/2f5e277.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Bazel build (bazel build //...)
